title: fab-line/v1 body
description: A production line the fab actually has — reference data that consumers turn into a closed choice (a dropdown), not prose. One document per line: the list is the document set, exactly like domain-skill, so a line is added or retired by pushing or archiving one document rather than editing a shared array. There are no tiered-value slots here: a line code is not a claim someone has to review, it either exists or it does not. The id is lower(code), so a consumer can list documents and know the codes without fetching each body.

code.description: What people write on a board and type into a form — the line's short identifier (L1, M2, P1). Uppercase because that is how it is written everywhere else; the id lowercases it.

name.description: Spliced into a single rendered line — no newline, no leading markdown block marker.
